privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content:
1. Information We Collect

We may collect personal information you voluntarily provide, including your name, contact number, email address, and house address when you submit feedback, register for volunteer activities, or use community services.

2. How We Use Your Information

  • To provide and maintain community services and facilities
  • To send important announcements, event notifications and service updates
  • To respond to your inquiries and feedback
  • To improve community management and user experience

3. Information Sharing

We do not sell, rent or disclose your personal information to third parties for commercial purposes.

4. Data Security

We adopt appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information.

5. Your Rights

You have the right to access, correct or request deletion of your personal information.

6. Contact Us

If you have any questions, please contact myceliumresidence07@gmail.com.

rules.title: Community Rules
rules.content:
1. Public Area Etiquette

Keep public areas clean and tidy. Take good care of public facilities.

2. Quiet Hours

Quiet hours are from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM daily.

3. Pet Management

Pets must be kept on a leash in public areas.
